scope: Independent supplied-source inventory and strict replay; scoped source endpoints; original write/result/effect/selector associations; source-rooted conditional production queries. Model interfaces, not authoritative native writer capture or readiness.
limitations: Given-file manifest/normalization closure does not prove all runtime writes, aliases, processes, windows or native content identity were captured.
Source PRODUCES records an observed result, not necessarily physical allocation or write. Cross-artifact bridges and host/work/native stage associations remain explicit conditional links.
Outcome and parsed byte-prefix result do not grant visibility, interval stability, quiescence, ready/free or transformation authority. P does not close V/R3 or full M0-M2.
No detector/backend/lowerer, LeWM/GPU profiling or speedup is added. The real OS witness separates native request/return from wrapper failure.
